label: Trustpilot Stars
purpose: Display a Trustpilot-style star rating with optional review-count text
_notes:
'rating' is the numeric star value (1-5). 'label' is inline_richtext text shown next to the stars, e.g. '(1,234 Reviews)' — must NOT be wrapped in

tags. Real schema does NOT have a 'trustpilot_url' or 'show_rating_text' setting (this is a purely visual Trustpilot-styled star widget, not a live Trustpilot integration) — put the full review-count text directly in 'label'. All remaining real settings (active/background/symbol star colors, text size, alignment, an anchor-link scroll_id, margins) are pure visual styling or technical anchors, omitted.
